subject: Edge node walkthrough + access sanity check for Lumacare private deployment
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@lumacare.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Edge nodes — walkthrough + access sanity check

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick responses on the onboarding thread. We're starting private deployment prep for Lumacare and would like a short technical walkthrough of the on‑prem edge nodes and a sanity check of our access controls before the environment handoff.

High level ask:
- Confirm firewall and egress rules required for Redwood runtime
- Verify service account and KMS integration approach
- Walk through port/IP allowlist and any outbound domain allowlist

We can do a 30‑40m call. Morning PT next Tue/Wed works for our infra team. Please let me know what artifacts we should share ahead of time.

Thanks,
Priya
Operations Lead, Lumacare

Attachment: lumacare-edge-inventory.csv (csv)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@lumacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Edge nodes — walkthrough + access sanity check

Hi Priya — thanks, happy to run that. Below is a compact prep checklist that speeds up the call and lets us validate remotely before an on‑site or bastion session. If you can drop the docs/exports below into the Drive link I sent, we can triage ahead of time.

Prep checklist (please share these if available):
- Network inventory (CIDR blocks for each edge rack / VLAN)
- Firewall rules / ACL export and NAT/Gateway IPs (ingress/egress)
- Egress domain allowlist (if outbound domain filtering is used)
- Service account identity model (OAuth2 client, service account email, or workload identity)
- KMS provider and key IDs (we support AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault or customer HSM)
- BASTION / jump host IP(s) and SSH key provisioning model
- Monitoring endpoints (metrics ingest, Prometheus endpoints, and collection ports)
- Time sync/NTP and DNS resolution policies

Quick technical notes to save time on the call:
- Outbound TLS to redwood runtime endpoints (443) must be allowed; we recommend allowlisting our runtime domains and IP ranges (we'll provide a CIDR file).
- If you're using a proxy/Gateway, we prefer a TLS passthrough (no MITM) for KV cache traffic; if MITM is required we need the CA chain for certificate validation.
- For KMS integration, we can support either key wrapping via a managed KMS or an HSM-backed signing flow; we will not accept long lived plaintext keys in transit.

Proposed times (PT): Tue 2027-04-06 09:30‑10:10, Wed 2027-04-07 10:00‑10:40. Which works for your infra folks?

I'll bring Marissa for deployment sequencing and Ben for Dedicated capacity sizing if we need to talk throughput.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: onboarding-checklist-template.pdf (stub)

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@lumacare.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lumacare IT <it@lumacare.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Edge nodes — walkthrough + access sanity check

Rafael — thanks, we can do Wed 10:00 PT. I've uploaded the inventory and a brief network diagram. A couple of notes up front:
- We operate a zero‑trust gateway that terminates outbound TLS for policy reasons; we can export the CA chain and the allowlist config.
- Service accounts: we use a vaulted short‑lived credential flow (HashiCorp Vault tokens) — we can provide the workflow doc and a sample token exchange.
- We have a handful of NAT egress IPs (listed in the CSV).

Attachments uploaded to Drive: network-diagram.png, lumacare-edge-inventory.csv.

Priya

On Wed 2027-04-07 10:00 PT — call confirmed (calendar invite sent).

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@lumacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Edge nodes — walkthrough + access sanity check

Thanks Priya — good walkthrough today. Summarizing action items and what we validated during the call: 

1) Firewall/Egress rules- Validated outbound NAT IPs and whitelisted our runtime domains for 443/TCP. Lumacare will add our CIDR file to the gateway allowlist; we've provided a small CIDR superset for immediate testing.

2) Zero‑trust gateway and TLS termination- You confirmed you must perform TLS termination. Lumacare will provide the CA chain and the allowlist extract. For the token/KV caching channels we'll run certificate pinning against the provided chain and validate with your security team.

3) KMS/service account- You are using Vault short‑lived creds. We validated a token‑exchange flow works with our connector. Next step: a one‑time test run where Lumacare's Vault issues a test token and we exercise a wrapped key fetch (no plaintext keys exchanged). Please provide a sample test token and the Vault API endpoint.

4) Bastion/access model- We recommend ephemeral jump hosts for handoff. Please provide the bastion public IP and the authorized SSH key thumbprint. We will only request ephemeral access for the duration of the activation window.

5) Monitoring and health probes- Confirmed outbound to our monitoring ingest endpoint (TLS 443) and that Prometheus scrape endpoints are reachable from the bastion for the smoke run.

Requested artifacts (upload to the Drive link):
- Firewall export (rule set + timestamped snapshot)
- CA chain + gateway allowlist extract
- Sample Vault test token (expires in 1 hour) and Vault API URL
- Bastion public IP and authorized key fingerprint
- ASN/BGP peer info if applicable (helps if you have private peering)

We'll run a remote validation session once those artifacts are uploaded. If any item needs an exception (e.g., cannot share a test token), call that out and we will adjust the validation plan.

Link to test plan draft: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_lumacare-onprem-handbook

—Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
